name: renewBook
intent: Renew the selected user's outstanding loan for the selected copy.
pre: A user with the supplied uid exists.
The user's borrowing status is NORMAL.
A copy with the supplied barcode exists with status LOANED.
An unreturned loan links this user and copy.
The loan's due date is later than today.
For a student, the loan has been renewed fewer than three times.
For a non-student, the loan has been renewed fewer than six times.
The loan's overdue fee equals zero.
post: Increase the loan's renewal count by one relative to its value before this operation.
Set the loan's renewal date to today.
For a BACHELOR student, extend the previous due date by 20 days.
For a MASTER student, extend the previous due date by 40 days.
For a student whose programme is neither BACHELOR nor MASTER, extend the previous due date by 60 days.
For a non-student, extend the previous due date by 60 days.
difficulty_basis: Subtype-dependent renewal limits and nested programme-dependent date arithmetic against previous due date.
scenarios: Four parameterized student/faculty cases cover 20/40/60/60 day extensions, renewal count/date/result; seedLoan inspected.
Student renewal count 3 violates strict limit.
Faculty renewal count 6 violates strict limit.
Positive overdue fee violates zero-fee guard.
effects_audit: Renewal extends prior due date, not today. No new loan, loan-count update, suspension-days guard or reservation update inferred.
